**verdict**: CANARY PASS (seed-disagreement on the lower-phase residual -- read this jointly with -s1 before treating STAND_HEIGHT rung-5 as cleared). Plain English: this is the FIRST canary testing whether the just-promoted mesh stancemix rise/hold/lower skill survives being (a) sequenced rise->hold->lower in one episode (mode_seq_stance) AND (b) given a moving height command during the hold segment ([-40,20]mm @15mm/s) at the same time -- and the answer is mostly yes, with a residual. Reward rises over the run on both seeds despite a shared mid-training valley (this seed: ep_rew_mean 2.4->peak~76@1M->trough -180@1.2M->recover to 144 final; -s1: 6.5->54->trough -216->66) -- matches the documented architecture-independent valley shape, not a stall. The gate's own pre-registered custom probe (--cfg-set goal.mode_seq_stance=1 mode_seq_hold_height_cmd=1 hold_height_cmd_frac=1, det+sto 6+6) shows REAL height tracking during hold on both seeds (herr_end 0.8-3.4mm det / 1.0-3.3mm sto here, tracking a moving target, not flat-ignored) and no majority over_current/fall on any mode (worst is exactly 6/12 on one seed's lower, at not over the pre-registered "<=6/12" bar). Rise mildly softened both seeds (4/6 det+4/6 sto success, 2 term each via over_current/hold_min_load). Lower is where this seed and -s1 DISAGREE: this seed (seed0) keeps lower alive with ZERO terminations but drifts high on herr for det (4/6 exceed the 15mm success bar, 18-20.5mm; sto stays inside, 6/6 success up to 13.1mm); -s1 has the OPPOSITE shape (lower/det tracks TIGHTLY, herr 0.3-2.0mm, but trips the over_current safety on ALL 6/6 det episodes right at/near the end; sto is clean 6/6). Both read as the campaign's long-documented current-margin fragility (cur_max pinned 2.4-2.64A near the safety ceiling on most rise/lower episodes) newly stacked onto the height-cmd+mode_seq composition -- not a new mechanism defect, and NOT a splay/press-pin collapse (video contact sheets: upright, all-six-planted stands throughout every reviewed strip, no visible fall/tip). A secondary, likely-cosmetic finding: the STANDARD isolated (non-composed) hold-only gate/owncfg probe is much more fragile on -s1 (4/6 and 3/6 hold_min_load terms from a cold "plant" reset) than on this seed (0-1 terms) even though -s1's hold is clean INSIDE the composed seqprobe -- probably an artifact of the isolated probe's own reset distribution, not the stage-2 pipeline's actual entry condition (rise always precedes hold there in practice). Net: the composition mechanism WORKS (tracks, doesn't collapse) but is not yet clean enough on both seeds to call rung-5 closed. Acting on the cheaper, no-new-code lever first: funding an 8M-budget continuation of BOTH seeds from their own 2M checkpoints (unchanged recipe) to see whether the still-rising Q4 reward trend closes the lower-phase residual before building a height-cmd-segment-specific bc_anchor-coef loosening.
